simulator.why_this_is_the_simulator: Contract said start at the ~6000-line module. hwir.py is 6279 lines and contains FUNCTIONAL_SIM, CYCLE_APPROX, COST_MODEL, U50-family profiles, Chestnut carrier envelopes, qGEMV pre-board, and PREHARDWARE lowering.

what_it_simulates.FUNCTIONAL_SIM: Host-CPU numpy interpreter of tools.future.fpga_engines.qgemv. Canonical kernel is M=2 K=4 weight_bits=4 group_size=4. y = sequential left-to-right fused dequant-then-MAC. Bit-exact against an independent golden in tests. Evidence tier FUNCTIONAL_SIM. Explicitly not a cycle count and not a board run.
what_it_simulates.CYCLE_APPROX: Critical-path modelled cycles: H2C queue+beats, then max(compute II/depth, HBM beats), then C2H. clock_hz=UNKNOWN. conversion_to_seconds=REFUSED. cycles_to_seconds() raises UnmeasuredConversionError.
what_it_simulates.COST_MODEL_HBM: Bytes moved per token. Resident weights do not move. modelled_cycles = ceil(per_token_bytes / hbm_bytes_per_modelled_cycle) with declared beat 1024. Not a measured HBM2 rate. DeviceProfile has no HBM GB/s field.
what_it_simulates.COST_MODEL_HOST_DEVICE: Activation H2C + partial-reduction C2H. Beat from (possibly Chestnut-downgraded) PCIe gen/lanes, or USB4_40G_CLASS prior if gen/lanes UNPINNED. bandwidth_gbps is deliberately absent (HARDWARE_FIELDS key).
what_it_simulates.STATIC_RESOURCES: LUT/DSP/BRAM/URAM estimator. fit_kernel_to_device raises ResourceOverBudget. Over-budget graphs fail validate() with RESOURCE_OVER_BUDGET.
what_it_simulates.PARTITION: Row-split on M so the resident packed shard fits hbm_capacity_bytes. 65/35 Apple/FPGA prior is recorded and NOT applied as physics. transport_policy=activations_and_partial_reductions_only.
what_it_simulates.CARRIER: CarrierEnvelope DOWNGRADES a DeviceProfile. chestnut_current_firmware pins PCIe Gen3 x2, observed_payload_bytes_per_s=1680000000, airflow=none. THIRD_PARTY_REPORTED. Not our measurement.
what_it_simulates.LOWERING: Equal-citizen HlsStyleEmitter and RustHdlEmitter emit PREHARDWARE source text (qgemv_hls_style.cpp / rust). Not synthesis. cannot_express and handwritten_hdl are mandatory non-empty.
what_it_simulates.SEALED_PREDICTIONS: 12 COST_MODEL/CYCLE_APPROX coefficients with falsifiers, keyed to wake_condition U50_PRESENT. Synthetic rehearsal is labeled NOT AN ARRIVAL.

what_it_does_not_simulate: A U50DD / XCU50 board, shell, XRT, bitstream, or Fmax
HBM2 channel physics, bank conflicts, or the 316 GB/s brochure rate (that number is a comment, not a sourced DeviceProfile field)
PCIe training, ASM2464PD completer behaviour, USB4 payload (Chestnut figures are THIRD_PARTY_REPORTED overlays)
Seconds, tok/s, joules, or any HARDWARE_MEASURED quantity (emit_evidence refuses HARDWARE_MEASURED)
DeltaNet / FFN / MTP / n-gram / attention as functional engines (simulate_functional returns ok=False unless organ==qgemv)
Engine ladder L5–L8 (canonical kernel is APPENDIX K.2 L1)

lower_fpga_domain_to_hwir non-test callers are none (tests only), while HwirGraph() inside it is what the capability graph counts as FPGA_HWIR WIRED from fusion_bridge.py:1444. That line is inside the lowering function. fusion_bridge.main constructs two_domain_plan but the HwirGraph call is only reached if lower_fpga_domain_to_hwir is invoked — tests and (if anyone calls it) production. Confirm: fusion_bridge.py:1474 is main() two_domain_plan, not lower. So fusion_bridge's HwirGraph call site is the function body at 1444; a definition's internal call is a call of HwirGraph, and the graph counts the file:line as runtime_caller. The function itself is only called from tests. This is a reachability subtlety: HwirGraph is called if that function runs; the function's only callers are tests.
surprises.would_settle: A non-test caller of lower_fpga_domain_to_hwir, or a graph rule that a call inside an uncalled function is not wired. Flagged rather than smoothed.
